metrics.name: avg / avg_placement
metrics.denominator: Games where entity was observed in final board state
metrics.interpretation: OBSERVATIONAL_ASSOCIATION: Mean final placement achieved by players holding this unit/item/comp at game end
metrics.reliability_class: B (Conditioning on game stage/star level not fully controlled)
metrics.causal_guard: NOT a causal treatment effect. Does NOT prove the item causes placement improvement.

metrics.name: count / games
metrics.population: Tracked MetaTFT matches in current sampling window
metrics.interpretation: Sample size (N) of the observed condition
metrics.causal_guard: Frequency reflects meta popularity and ease of hitting, not standalone strength.

metrics.name: place_change
metrics.denominator: Baseline cluster placement vs itemized cluster placement
metrics.interpretation: MetaTFT internal delta between base comp average placement and itemized variant average placement
metrics.causal_guard: Confounded by player economy and surviving rounds needed to craft 3 items.

metrics.name: score / adjusted_score
metrics.interpretation: MetaTFT internal heuristic ranking score for recommended builds
metrics.reliability_class: C (Proprietary algorithm with undisclosed exact weights)
metrics.causal_guard: DO NOT use as an empirical probability in DecisionEngine.

metrics.name: percentile
metrics.causal_guard: Benchmark descriptive metric for evaluating player standing.
